about.title: About Us
about.heroTagline:
Born in Bonn,
obsessed with perfection.
about.storyBody: Crunkie was born from a simple but ambitious idea: cookies should be as exciting as any premium food experience. Based in Bonn, Germany, we craft each cookie with premium ingredients and the kind of care that shows in every bite.
about.storyBody2: What started as an obsession became a brand. Our signature mini box concept turned cookie giving into an experience, and our rotating flavors keep even our regulars guessing. We're proud to be Cologne–Bonn's most talked-about cookie.

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.body: Only the finest ingredients — Belgian chocolate, Sicilian pistachios, ceremonial matcha, real vanilla. No shortcuts.

design.title: Design Thinking
design.body: Every cookie, box and experience is designed to delight — from the first look to the last crumb.

craft.title: Artisan Craft
craft.body: Handcrafted in small batches. Never mass-produced. Always made with intent and a little bit of love.

b2b.title: Crunkie for Business
b2b.heroBody: From corporate gifting to hotel amenities and event catering — we create cookie experiences your guests, clients and employees will remember.

corporate.title: Corporate & Teams
corporate.body: Surprise your team with premium cookie boxes. Perfect for onboarding gifts, milestone celebrations, client appreciation and office events.

hotels.title: Hotels & Hospitality
hotels.body: Elevate your guest experience with our signature cookie amenities. Available in custom packaging with your branding.

events.title: Events & Weddings
events.body: Custom cookie boxes for weddings, conferences, trade shows and private events. Fully customizable with your name, colors and message.

b2b.miniBoxBody: A curated selection of Crunkie flavors in our iconic mini box — the perfect gift, party favor or corporate giveaway. Beautifully packaged, impossible to forget.
b2b.frozenBody: Order our premium frozen cookies and bake them fresh whenever you need them. Ready in minutes in a microwave or conventional oven. Perfect for hotel minibar service, event catering and corporate pantries.
b2b.customBody: White-label cookie boxes with your company logo, event name or personal message. Minimum orders apply — contact us for details and pricing.
b2b.ctaBody: Send us a message and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear from you.

q1.question: It's 2AM. You're:
q1.b: Last one on the dance floor.

q2.question: Your Sunday vibe:
q2.b: Farmers market, matcha, maybe a journal.

barely-legal.personality: You don't do anything halfway. You're the person who turns a regular Tuesday into an occasion — and makes it look effortless. A bit illegal? Maybe. Unforgettable? Always.

berry-trouble.personality: Playful but precise. You show up unexpected and somehow make everything better. People say trouble — you call it an adventure.

blackout.personality: All in, no apologies. You live at full volume and the night is your territory. You don't do things halfway — or at all, apparently.

chocolate.personality: Timeless. Dependable. The one everyone comes back to. You don't need to be loud — your presence says enough.

clean-cheat.personality: You have values — and you refuse to compromise on them. That's not restraint. That's identity. And somehow, it's the most satisfying choice in the room.

flex.personality: Why settle for one when you can have everything? You bring the energy, the ideas, and somehow still have time for everyone. The ultimate triple threat.

golden.personality: Optimistic, reliable, and quietly radiant. You're the person who makes everywhere feel like a good place to be. The warm kind of magic that doesn't ask for credit.

habit.personality: The quiet constant everyone counts on. Not flashy, not loud — just consistently, remarkably good. The kind of reliable that earns loyalty for life.

hazel.personality: You bring depth and warmth to everything you touch. Inspired by the world, grounded in craft — the grown-up in the room who never lost the fun.

lotus.personality: You make warmth feel like an art form. Spiced, layered, impossible to get enough of. People come for one reason and stay for ten.

matcha-kiss.personality: You're ahead of the curve — always. Mindful, aesthetic, with a subtle intensity that draws people in. The room notices when you arrive.

nightshift.personality: You do your best work when everyone else has clocked out. Sharp, focused, powered by something darker than most. Sleep is optional. Excellence is not.

oreo.personality: Instantly beloved. You carry a comfort that feels familiar and thrilling at once. Nobody regrets having you around — they always wish there was more.

peel-me-slow.personality: Fresh, unexpected, and impossible to ignore. You're the one who walks in and the whole room wakes up. Citrus-sharp and impossible to forget.

pistachio.personality: Selective, sophisticated, and quietly exceptional. You're not for everyone — which is exactly what makes you so sought after.

redflag.personality: Bold, spicy, and somehow irresistible despite every warning sign. You're the one they said to avoid — and the one they can't stop thinking about.

salt.personality: You understand balance better than almost anyone. The contrast is the whole point — and you've made it a lifestyle. Sweet and sharp. Grounded and surprising.

softspot.personality: Warmth, comfort, and the kind of presence that makes everyone exhale. You're the reason people feel at home. The soft spot everyone secretly has for you? Earned.

vegan-vice.personality: Your principles aren't negotiable — and neither is your intensity. You do things fully, your way, without shortcuts. Plant-based, principle-driven, completely unapologetic.

walnut.personality: Rustic, honest, and deeply satisfying. You don't need the spotlight — your presence speaks for itself. The kind of person who feels like coming home.
